// facing the door. Chair (stairs) at z59 facing it, a 3x3 rug in the middle, a barrel with a pot in the north-east
// corner, a hanging lantern over the rug and a standing lantern on the floor at the south-west of the rug. The west doorway (x62, z56..57) and the south windows (x65..66, z61) stay clear.
// Furnishing layout kept as data. build() does not write it: the shell carves every interior cell to air and runParts
// locks those cells (air included), so each write was refused and the room came out empty. Restore the layers() call

  B: "barrel",
  F: "flower_pot",
  W: "white_carpet",

  C: "water_cauldron",
  G: "glass_pane",
  I: "iron_bars",
  L: ["lantern", { hanging: "true" }],
  T: ["lantern", { hanging: "false" }],
};
// rows run along +x (x63..68), successive rows along +z (z54..60); one layer per y (y4..y9)

  // y4 floor: barrel NE corner, rug x64..66 z56..58, chair z59, washstand cabinet x63..64 z60
  [".....B", EMPTY, ".WWW..", ".WWW..", ".TWW..", ".S....", "KK...."],
  // y5: pot on the barrel, water basin and a pot on the washstand
  [".....F", EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, "CF...."],
  // y6..7: mirror panes on the wall behind the basin
  [EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, "GG...."],
  [EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, "GG...."],

];

  // Nothing is written: every cell of this room is already owned by the shell (see the note above).

The fix is outside this part: runParts (or the shell's air fill over x27..68 z43..60 y3..17) must let room parts write into shell-carved interior air. Once that changes, rerun ./make.sh and check with `mcd room build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --only 'powder room'`, expecting OK with min 8.
Every room part reports placed 0 in parts-report.json, so the same lock blocks all 37 rooms' furniture and lights, not just the powder room.

waste.what: Found out by trial that the shell's air claim makes runParts refuse every room write, including the lantern. I only learned it after a rebuild, and then had to test the lamp placement on a scratch copy by hand.

waste.what: Worked out the lantern spot cell by cell (manhattan distance from each floor cell to the lamp, needing 8 or more) because the lamp suggestions from `mcd room` were for the whole room's corner case, not a single centred spot.
waste.cost: Roughly 40 floor cells checked in my head, plus two suggestion runs.
waste.tool: `mcd room --rooms ... --suggest 1` that picks the single best free floor cell (or hanging spot) for a target light level, keeping walk clear.
